name: Cell-Projection Volume Rendering
definition: A method that starts with the data set's cells and integrates color and opacity for multiple pixels under the data cell's projected area, employing a hybrid approach between ray tracing and z-buffer rendering.
summary: Cell-Projection Volume Rendering is a distributed algorithm that projects unstructured mesh cells into image space to generate ray segments, avoiding global depth-sorting and using asynchronous communication to hide data transfer overheads.
